source.text:
I appreciate it. One overlooked part of education is that it is supposed to teach these values.

When I was going to primary school, we'd take oath every day before the classes started - first line were to the effect of - "I swear that I will occupy myself with serving the humanity".

I guess that's why I refused when one of my longest serving freelance web development client inquired if I was interested in developing a "naughty" website.
